newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +3.72 pct vs mark/dlr basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +3.72 pct vs mark/dlr basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Thursday fixed the crown at 27.342 to the dollar after Wednesday's fixing at 27.307, and at 17.340 to the mark from 17.394.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +3.72 percent, after a deviation of +3.57 on Wednesday.
When the central bank calculated today's fixing, the crown was trading on the interbank market at +3.72 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT), and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated at 1130 CET.
